# Contrast

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

WCAG 2.2 relative luminance and contrast-ratio maths for sRGB colours.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`Ratio`](#ratio): WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio between two sRGB colours, in [1, 21].
- [`RelativeLuminance`](#relativeluminance): WCAG 2.2 relative luminance of an sRGB colour, in [0, 1].
- [`RequiredRatio`](#requiredratio): The WCAG 2.2 AA ratio required for text of this size, per SC 1.4.3.
- [`Round`](#round): Rounds to 2 decimal places, so both implementations agree on borderline cases.
- [`TryParseHexRgb`](#tryparsehexrgb): Parses a "#rrggbb" string into 0-255 channels.

### `Ratio`

```csharp
double Ratio(ValueTuple<byte, byte, byte> a, ValueTuple<byte, byte, byte> b)
```

*static*

WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio between two sRGB colours, in [1, 21]. Order-independent: the lighter colour is always the numerator.

### `RelativeLuminance`

```csharp
double RelativeLuminance(ValueTuple<byte, byte, byte> rgb)
```

*static*

WCAG 2.2 relative luminance of an sRGB colour, in [0, 1]. Black is 0, white is 1.

### `RequiredRatio`

```csharp
double RequiredRatio(float? fontSize, bool bold)
```

*static*

The WCAG 2.2 AA ratio required for text of this size, per SC 1.4.3.

Sizes are in points, which is PDF's native unit — the CSS px conversion (18pt = 24px, 14pt bold = 18.66px) does not apply here.

### `Round`

```csharp
double Round(double ratio)
```

*static*

Rounds to 2 decimal places, so both implementations agree on borderline cases.

### `TryParseHexRgb`

```csharp
bool TryParseHexRgb(string hex, out ValueTuple<byte, byte, byte> rgb)
```

*static*

Parses a "#rrggbb" string into 0-255 channels. Returns false for any value that is not exactly six hex digits after the hash, so a malformed snapshot degrades to "unknown" rather than to a wrong verdict.
